Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before you join.

Are there any extra charges other than ₹499?▾

No, there are no extra charges at all. The programme fee is only ₹499.

Do I have to buy any products?▾

Not at all. You do not have to purchase any products, powders or supplements.

Is a vegetarian diet available?▾

Yes. Whether you are vegetarian or non-vegetarian, your diet will be modified according to your preference.

Can I eat normal home food?▾

Yes. The plan is made with normal home food, so it is very easy to follow.

How soon will I get my diet chart?▾

As soon as you join, you will get your diet chart immediately.

How will the follow-up work?▾

There is a follow-up every week, and if needed, every 2-3 days.

Will the diet change according to my progress?▾

Yes. Your diet will be changed according to your progress.
